system_identification.name: the Membrane
system_identification.environment: operator self-hosted deployments per docs/reference-stack.md and docs/edge-deployment.md

system_surface_framework.name: MAESTRO
system_surface_framework.version: unversioned; CSA seven-layer agent-stack model as reproduced in ov-poc-standard v0.1 C9

grading_basis: met = implemented as the requirement reads and verifiable in the public repo today; not independently audited

claims.mechanism: Operator-signed IAC recorded at issuance, bound to the chain head before first use
claims.verifiable_fact: The granted permission set, scope and expiry are written to the execution record before the first action under them

claims.mechanism: Per-call re-evaluation against IAC and hot-reloaded registry, again before dispatch
claims.verifiable_fact: Every action is evaluated at execution time and the decision record names the matched rule or denial reason

claims.mechanism: Fail-closed refusal at the gateway with blocked-action receipts; exact attempted request held in the durable journal
claims.verifiable_fact: Out-of-scope actions are blocked, not flagged, and each block writes a rejection record naming the attempted action

claims.mechanism: Per-task, caller-bound IACs with short TTLs (1-300s via OIDC exchange; reissue capped at 7 days)
claims.verifiable_fact: Credentials are issued per task with scope and expiry; no standing broad-scope credential is available to the agent

claims.mechanism: Signed membrane.approval.decision events recording approver OIDC subject, exact call hash, decision, timestamp; one-shot approvals
claims.verifiable_fact: Each human approval writes a record with the approver's authenticated identity, the exact content presented, the decision and its timestamp
claims.notes: Tool calls only, single approver, no live IdP exercise yet

claims.mechanism: Deterministic read-only advisor; approvals bind the original grant and policy digest
claims.verifiable_fact: Advisory outputs cannot raise the authorization state of subsequent actions; approval thresholds evaluate against the original grant

claims.mechanism: Schnorr signature, expiry, audience, scope and nonce replay-cache validation before execution
claims.verifiable_fact: Each action's signed authorization token is cryptographically validated before execution and failures are recorded

claims.mechanism: Permission as intersection of IAC, registry grant and global policy; OIDC exchange refuses anything outside the live grant
claims.verifiable_fact: A delegate's permission set structurally cannot exceed the delegator's; escalation attempts are rejected and recorded

claims.mechanism: Gateway as separate process and required path; agents hold no model/tool credentials; reference deployment confines backend access, CI-verified
claims.verifiable_fact: All agent tool and effect invocations route through the interception gateway; no-bypass is deployment-enforced

claims.mechanism: Journal stores intent and publication marker, then the signed CP, before any dispatch; a pending marker blocks dispatch and startup
claims.verifiable_fact: Evidence emission is a precondition of action release

claims.mechanism: Documented claim discipline: receipts attest request intent before dispatch, not execution success
claims.verifiable_fact: The claim does not assert that evidence describes executed actions

claims.mechanism: Receipts and journal frames written in the execution path with capture timestamps, hash-chained at the time of the action
claims.verifiable_fact: Each evidence record is written within the executing transaction, not batch-reconstructed later

claims.mechanism: Hash-chained receipts (parent_cp_hash), checksummed hash-linked journal, seq/prev/hash SIEM spool verified at startup
claims.verifiable_fact: Modifying, inserting or reordering a record invalidates the chain
claims.notes: Strict reading: verification is startup/continuous, not on a stated schedule; the Merkle rollup carries the self-disclosed defects in membrane-hq/the-membrane#62

claims.mechanism: Evidence schema fields restricted to identifiers, digests, timestamps and decision results
claims.verifiable_fact: No evidence field asserts quality, correctness or intent

claims.mechanism: Hardened export spools failures, emits gap envelopes, reports degraded state in /health; alarm engine covers grant-expiry and denial streaks
claims.verifiable_fact: Evidence-pipeline failures raise a monitored alert and are written as failure events
claims.notes: Documented caveat: the dropped count in a gap is memory-held across a crash

claims.mechanism: Per-source monotonic seq with prev/hash linkage; sequence-numbered journal frames; incrementing scope session nonces
claims.verifiable_fact: A verifier can detect a missing record from the sequence gap alone

claims.mechanism: fail_closed mode refuses new calls with 503 before any upstream effect; journal corruption or a pending publication marker blocks dispatch and startup
claims.verifiable_fact: When evidence cannot be generated at the claimed Tier, in-scope actions are refused until the pipeline recovers

claims.mechanism: Published machine-readable JSON Schemas for IAC, bus events, router CPs, SIEM events and rollup bundles, with version constants in records
claims.verifiable_fact: The evidence claim set is defined by a machine-readable schema a verifier can obtain
claims.notes: Schemas are repo files, not yet hosted at their $id URLs

disclosed_gaps.reason: Per-tool typed validation exists for the shipped GitHub tools and spend only; no generic registered-schema validator
Single delegation hop only (operator to caller); no multi-hop chains
No confidential delegation or ZK credential presentation
One signed record per decision point, not three signed before/during/after records; raised with the working group
OpenTimestamps rollup exists but is optional, excluded from air-gap builds, on no declared interval
No hardware attestation or attestation-bound signing key
Receipts signed under operator-held keys - the Tier 2 ceiling disclosed in ov-poc-standard#139
No equivocation resistance; chain heads publish to an operator-run relay
Merkle defects in membrane-hq/the-membrane#62; no inclusion-proof API
No consistency proofs between published roots
Evidence store is local files under OS permissions; no RBAC or read auditing
No retention period stated or configured; full history retained without compaction
No declared anchoring interval and no missed-deadline alert
Duplicate JSON object keys resolve last-wins; no duplicate-key rejection

trust_assumptions.subject: Operator-held signing keys (Schnorr/secp256k1)
trust_assumptions.assumption: The operator controls the keys that sign IACs and receipts; a compromised operator key can forge evidence. Caps every claim at Tier 2.

trust_assumptions.subject: SHA-256 and Schnorr/secp256k1
trust_assumptions.assumption: Collision resistance and signature unforgeability hold. Algorithm identity is pinned by schema version, not per-field tags.

trust_assumptions.subject: Operator-run relay
trust_assumptions.assumption: Chain-head publication depends on a relay the operator runs; it is not an independent witness and provides no equivocation resistance.

trust_assumptions.subject: Operator's OIDC identity provider
trust_assumptions.assumption: Approval records are only as strong as the IdP's authentication of the approver.

trust_assumptions.subject: Host OS and filesystem
trust_assumptions.assumption: Evidence stores are local files under OS permissions; no role-based access and no read auditing of evidence.

trust_assumptions.subject: Reference deployment confinement
trust_assumptions.assumption: No-bypass holds where the reference deployment confines backend access (CI-verified in deploy/edge/verify.sh); other deployments must reproduce it.

trust_assumption_categories_absent.Hardware: no TEE, TPM or HSM in use

maintenance: Entries reflect main @ 9e357a3 (2026-11-09). Re-grade on changes to cited files; the register carries a required maestro_layers field on every claim (schema-enforced).
